recognize_zh: 骨髓切片被成片、胞質淡粉紅帶條紋的組織球取代，類似 Gaucher 細胞；高倍下少數組織球內有折光性橘紅色菱形結晶，其間夾雜小群漿細胞，應想到結晶儲積組織球增生症（crystal-storing histiocytosis）並追查背後的漿細胞腫瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic, fibrillary/striated cytoplasm replacing most of the marrow space
Small, bland, oval to irregular histiocyte nuclei with low N:C ratio
Occasional refractile, orange-pink intracytoplasmic rhomboid crystalline inclusions (panel B, green arrows)
Small interstitial clusters of darker mononuclear cells (plasma cells per history) between histiocytes (panel A, green arrows)
Markedly reduced residual hematopoiesis and scattered fat spaces; bony trabeculae at top and bottom of panel A
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows a hypercellular marrow in which the intertrabecular space is largely effaced by diffuse sheets of histiocytes with abundant pale pink, striated cytoplasm, imparting a Gaucher-like appearance. At high power, occasional histiocytes contain refractile, eosinophilic rhomboid crystalline inclusions. Small clusters of plasma cells are interspersed between the histiocytes and are easily overlooked on H&E; CD138 and kappa/lambda staining are required to demonstrate the clonal population. Residual normal hematopoiesis is markedly reduced. Findings are consistent with crystal-storing histiocytosis associated with a kappa-restricted plasma cell neoplasm (plasma cell myeloma).

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm without refractile rhomboid crystals and lack an accompanying clonal plasma cell population, whereas CSH crystals are immunoglobulin light chain (usually kappa) deposits.
Mycobacterial histiocytes lack crystals and contain acid-fast bacilli on AFB stain, often with granulomas.
The striated-appearing cells of CSH are CD68/CD163-positive histiocytes, not desmin/myogenin- or S100-positive cells.
LCH cells have grooved nuclei and are CD1a/langerin-positive with eosinophils, and ECD shows foamy CD68+/CD1a- histiocytes with BRAF V600E and fibrosis, neither containing light-chain crystals.
